region_scene_page.standard: After hip-hop's early and golden-age breakthroughs, East Coast 90s rap sharpened boom-bap production and street storytelling into a dominant album-era language. region_scene_page.deep: After hip-hop's early and golden-age breakthroughs, East Coast 90s rap sharpened boom-bap production and street storytelling into a dominant album-era language. The drums hit square and dry while the MC carries detail, threat, humor, and autobiography. Method Man, Wu-Tang Clan's C.R.E.A.M., Onyx's Slam, and The Notorious B.I.G.'s Big Poppa give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
